command.name: Basic Meter Setup
command.description: Configures the basic metering parameters of the meter.

parameters.name: Command Semaphore
parameters.description: A non-zero value triggers the command execution.

parameters.name: Number of Phases
parameters.description: Specifies the number of phases in the metering system.

parameters.description: Specifies the number of wires in the metering system.

parameters.name: VT Connection Type
parameters.description: Specifies the VT connection type in decimal form.
